notes.title: Small Update - 0.6.15
notes.notes:
Backrooms Society 0.6.15

-Added crossroad signs close to the central crossroad on level 9

-Added road name signs close to the halfway mark of each road

-Fixed watchers being unable to pass through some doors in metro levels

-Moved the location of some skinstealer nests on level 9

-Small audio adjustments to death rat scream

-Volume adjustments to the sound effects when unlocking the outpost gate on level 9

-Added a shortcut cave passage to one of the longest and most empty tunnels on level 2.6

-Added a temporary failsafe for the lost documents objective on level 9 - If for some reason the documents would fail to spawn at the given location (incredibly small chance) the failsafe should kick in after 30 minutes and automatically give the player the documents.

For those of you who are still looking for the treasure added in the last small update - the first hint is located somewhere in The Hub. :)

Something I forgot to add in the 0.6 patch notes - All level descriptions have been rewritten to better fit the games version of the levels.

• Added Tactical flashlight reload (on R when battery is below half)

• New Meshes and Textures for blueprints – easier to spot in the world

Thank you all for your patience!

This update took longer than expected, but it’s finally here. I’m excited to hear your thoughts, and all feedback is welcome. If you come across any bugs or have suggestions, please join the Discord channel linked below. :)

notes.title: 0.5.51 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Backrooms Society 0.5.51 - Hotfix

• Fixed bug that made the game unable to create new savefiles for inventory/storage.

• Fixed "exploration status" displaying double the actual exploration percentage in metro levels.

• Completely reworked the backend logic for selecting/creating new characters to make it more reliable.

To all players who spent a long time in-game yesterday and couldn't save/load their inventory, I sincerely apologize, it should work fine now. :)

notes.title: Regular Update #3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The halloween event has now ended. I am still working on the next major update, but in the meantime I have some quality of life improvements/features for you. :)

-Player to Player trading system. (should help decrease drop trade scamming)

-Improved voice chat audio/occlusion

-"Push to talk" has been changed to "toggle mic"

-Voice volume slider

-Tweaked the logic for changing spray paint pattern (should hopefully fix some of the issues with clients not seeing the right pattern)

-Fix some bugs caused by lighting the Bacteria on fire

-Fixed several other minor bugs

-Added more loot in Level 117 lockers, replacing the halloween loot spawns


Known current issues (should hopefully be fixed soon)

-First person arms jittering when looking up/down

-Camera clipping into players head when opening inventory


I hope you all enjoyed our first event and hope you'll enjoy these new changes, there's lots more to come! :)

notes.title: Major Update #1
notes.notes:
Major Update #1

Good evening, everyone.

The first major update is now available. It's been a long time coming, and I hope you still have interest in the game. If so, then thank you for your patience.

Level 117
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43870810/8328b3ee18c831876d6710ef2dfaef0ecb188d46.png

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43870810/d72f87c6a4ad56ee331dbca6fcb57decd9e9dfd7.png

WARNING: To those of you who have changed your keybindings in the past, you might have to go through them and make sure none of them have been overridden or have the same key set for multiple bindings.

FEATURES

• New level - Level 117, Class 4 Difficulty.

• 2 New Entities with unique mechanics.

• Multiple New items, contracts, and recipes.

• Badges - You can now unlock badges to display your triumphs.

• Journal - A new UI element containing all your gathered Entity pages (they are now interactive) with extra info, unlocked level info with completion and expedition stats, character info/stats, unlocked badges, and a page of all your current contracts, etc.

• Research Level System - You now have levels associated with each entity and a total research level displayed in your journal. Gain XP by completing research contracts associated with the entity, take photos, or exploit their weaknesses. Leveling up will earn you unique entity badges, money, and add to your total research level.

• New general areas and a hidden new "Pipedreams" section added to "Level 2.6," along with an alternate exit from the level.

• New "dynamic weather system," a big new section, and other additions to "Level 84."

• Proximity Voice Chat (Experimental) - With a player list where you can mute/unmute players. (Check controls to see new keybinds and/or rebind them)

• Expedition Summary and Exploration Reward - Once you successfully make it out of a level, you will now be shown an "expedition summary" screen, displaying stats, time, and rewarding you for "exploration." Your highest reached "%" is displayed in your journal.

• Character Display - Opening your inventory will now flip the camera and display your character in 3rd person, so you can see yourself in all the glorious bling you've gathered.

• In-Game Playerlist (separate from the voice chat playerlist) - The session host will now have all the players in their game displayed in the ESC menu with a kick button available (Should make public sessions more manageable).

• New Contracts Screen - Interacting with the bulletin board in traders keep will now open a separate UI for claiming contracts, making you able to see categories of contracts and then hover over them to see the full description before claiming it. This also separates the available contracts for all players, so everyone in the session can choose from their own list of contracts.

• New Contract-specific slots in your inventory; you are now limited to carrying 6 contracts at a time (with exception for the hotbar slots), but this also means that you can carry 6 active contracts at all times without wasting any of that precious inventory space.

• Save/Character Slots - You can now create and name up to 4 separate characters in the main menu and switch between them before starting or joining a game. The characters are completely separate saves, which means journal progress, inventory, and hub storage.

• Blackmarket - Hidden black market buildings can be found in several levels. You're lucky if you find one during working hours, but if you do, make sure to have your rare and sketchy items on you along with some money for those dirt-cheap deals.

• New Hound - The hound has a completely new model, sounds, and animations, along with some changes to its behavior and reaction to its weakness.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43870810/1bad6e1b1025107029d662cbe27921cb21788c26.png

• Configurable Movement Keys - You can now rebind your movement keys (W, A, S, D - Default) and other new keybinds.

• Accessories Slot - You can now find and equip cosmetic accessories (more to come).

• New Unlockable Storage Room - More storage and a new mechanic.

• Traders Keep redesigned.

• FOV Slider added to options menu.

• New Bacteria sounds and altered animations.

• Alternate Exit added to Level 0.

CHANGES AND BUG FIXES

• No more body blocking - Collision with other players and entities has been removed, as it could cause problems when teleporting a player and to spare you some frustration on Level 2.6.

• Smoother camera movement when crouching, running, and zooming in/out.

• Complete visual redesign of all UI elements.

• More Crafting categories (should make it easier to find what you need to craft).

• Multiple Fixes for characters not stopping sprinting and draining stamina.

• Multiple Text chat fixes - This should hopefully also fix the issue with being assigned the wrong name. If you encounter a similar bug after this update, I would highly appreciate it if you report it on Discord or the community hub.

• Fixed multiple item duplication exploits and many more small bugs.

I've worked hard to ensure that this update brings some much-needed improvements and fun new features. I'm planning to expand even more on these new features with another update in the next few weeks, which should also bring some more useful features that I haven't had the time to finish with this one.

Enjoy! :)

•A few changes and additions to level 2.6 (Don't trust the walls)

notes.title: Small Update #1
notes.notes:
Good evening, everyone.
Thank you all for your incredible support and proven interest for the future of the game. I couldn't ask for anything more. :)
Here comes the first "real" update since the launch of Early Access, I hope these changes and additions will make some parts of the game a bit more enjoyable.


•Reworked Smilers and Hounds, some new information about them has appeard in Level 0 and Level 84.

•Added a new Flashlight mechanic on "LMB" and an updated description.

•Adjustments and additions to Level 84: 
  -Added a hidden alternative exit to a different level
  -Added some more subtle guidance towards safe zones 
  -Made all safe zone and exit lamp posts a bit taller 
  -changed some lighting and looks of the level (hopefully it also gives a bit of a performance boost)
  -Added a new hidden area to the level
  -Central safe zone now acts as a sort of checkpoint

•Increased Spray Paint range (can now reach the floor without crouching)

•You can now close your inventory with "Escape"!

•Removed Motion Blur (will probably add an option for it in the future)

•A few subtle UI changes.

•Added missing recipe for Completed Flower Contract and fixed the contract not being able to be stored in wallet/contract archive.

•More contracts available to pick up in Traders Keep.

•New greater Flower contract added with a special reward.

•Fixed a bug with most entities losing aggro from nowhere and some other weird behavior.

•Bacteria AI has been tweaked to make it a bit less prone to aggro from far and reduced the required time to be out of sight to lose aggro a small amount.

•Bacteria will now retreat "somewhere" after being burnt.

•"Almond Energy +" will no longer stop you mid sprint when you drink it (it will still stop your sprint once it's duration runs out)


Hope you enjoy!
